description: Change the URL, events or signing secret of a registered webhook. Free: this call never spends credits. A new URL changes where completion events, and the results they carry, are delivered; a new event list changes which events are sent.

events.description: New list of events, at least one.

secret.description: New shared secret for HMAC signature verification.

url.description: New URL for the events, http or https. The API refuses a host that resolves to a private or internal address.

name: update_webhook
title: Update a webhook (free)
